action_summary: Executes the counterfactual that the previous round could only index toward, instead of reading the failure text: instrument every if/while test in a copy of the module, flip ONE firing of one guard, and let the project's own pytest say whether that firing was the wrong one. The refinement is not searched for either -- the same hook logs what was in scope at every firing and the predicate is selected by exact fit against those values, so the operator stores zero parameters and spends one calculated bit per candidate. On the in-sample case (click@1b0e19f505) it derives the human's fix in 90 flips and 53.7 s. On 15 FRESH mechanically selected real commits it reaches the human's changed line 3 times and the human's expression 0 times; seven flips made the failing test green, all seven broke other tests in the file, and none admitted an exact-fit refinement. The round therefore falsifies its own premise and narrows the frontier: the intervention is free, the index is cheap, and what is missing is the replacement expression.
